title: Foreign-exchange return series
note: Five source-labelled ForEx log-return windows. Shared source and a stable feature-space group; windows need not be statistically independent.

title: BasicMotions walking recordings
note: All ten source-labelled walking instances. This group separates cleanly at PCA100/k80; increasing k on PCA20 did not reliably remove running/standing mixtures.

title: Two-dimensional wave simulations
note: Six wave-2D series across different M and T, with recurring spatial/temporal texture visible in all members. Already coherent at k40: higher k is not needed here. Only 79% of retained entries are observed, but separation strengthens using fully observed features. Its boundary is not perfectly isolated.

title: LEGION oscillator parameter variants
note: Five source-labelled LEGION series with different parameter sets and lengths. Shared generator family is known from source identifiers; a shared dynamical regime has not been independently established.

title: Wave-1D and hysteresis-model series
note: Four wave-1D series and one hysteresis-oscillator series. Repeated oscillatory patterns are visible, although spatial patterns and waveforms differ. Only 63% of retained entries are observed; separation remains positive on fully observed features. This supports inspecting the cross-model association, not mechanistic equivalence.

title: ArticularyWordRecognition and EigenWorms
note: Eight articulatory recordings plus one EigenWorms recording. All are smooth in sample units, but median linear-trend R2 is 0.21-0.60 in the articulatory series versus 0.015 in the worm recording. Membership is reproducible, but the shared mechanism remains unexplained; recording durations and sampling rates differ or are unknown.

title: Financial levels, Brownian simulations and HCP fMRI
note: Two financial series, three arithmetic-Brownian simulations and one HCP task-fMRI series (without a real/synthetic source tag). All have strong linear trends (median channel R2 0.55-0.88); fMRI lag-1 correlation is 0.80 versus 0.99-1.00 for the other members. Shared trend structure is a plausible explanation, but dynamical equivalence is not supported.
